title: HisabDo Department 3 knowledge record
description: One cleaned, approved piece of HisabDo knowledge (a FAQ answer or one section of a page). Version 1.0, 2026-11-10.

record_id.description: Stable id: source id, position, slug of the heading

title.description: Title of the source page (its h1)

section.description: Section of the page (h2); 'A > B' when a one-line intro was merged into B

heading.description: The FAQ question, or the section heading

category.description: Source category from the audit register

product_module.description: HisabDo product module the record is about

expense_management_scope.description: True for the expense-management modules (expenses, udhar, payables, ledger, reports, entry, bookkeeping)

scope.description: About the app, the company, a legal page, or general bookkeeping practice

source_url.description: Official page the text was taken from

last_updated.description: Date shown on the page; null when the page shows none (never guessed)

review_policy.description: Review policy from the audit register

approval.description: Approval status; only approved sources are ingested

usage.description: reference_only: legal text, quote and link, never interpret

notes.description: Why a record needs confirmation, if it does

content.description: Markdown: '## heading' + the cleaned source text
